response.content:
At a given pH, the protonated fraction is

\[
f=\frac{1}{1+10^{\mathrm{pH}-\mathrm{p}K_a}}
\]

For oxyhemoglobin:

\[
f_{HHbO_2}=\frac{1}{1+10^{7.4-6.62}}\approx 0.142
\]

For deoxyhemoglobin:

\[
f_{HHb}=\frac{1}{1+10^{7.4-8.18}}\approx 0.858
\]

When \(O_2\) is released, hemoglobin becomes more protonated, so the bound protons per \(O_2\) are

\[
\Delta f=0.858-0.142\approx 0.716
\]

Answer: F
